reasons.plausibility: Proposing an aluminized surface scale to protect from oxidation is scientifically plausible and in line with known oxidation-resistant coating strategies, though there's some uncertainty about mechanical property retention.
reasons.testability: Side-by-side oxidation and mechanical tests on coated vs. uncoated samples can verify or falsify the protective effect and mechanical implications decisively.
reasons.usefulness: This approach directly addresses oxygen resistance degradation in high-entropy alloys through a widely recognized oxidation-protection strategy, making it a valuable research direction.
